property_summary: For any recipient whose fallback consumes more than 2300 gas (e.g., an accepting fallback that uses more gas), the reference contract using transfer will always revert when owner calls withdrawAll (so address(c).balance remains unchanged), whereas the mutant using call can succeed and drain the balance; thus the invariant is that when sending to a recipient whose fallback uses >2300 gas, withdrawAll must revert (preserving address(c).balance) — the mutant violates this for some such recipients.
change_summary: Use call instead of transfer to forward funds to the recipient (semantically different due to gas/behavior).
